task.title: Access your Red Hat account after linking your company SSO
task.shortdesc: Use your Red Hat login to log in to your Red Hat account when it is enabled to use company single sign-on (SSO) integration.

ul.li: Ensure you have a registered Red Hat user account.
Confirm that your Red Hat company account is set up to use company SSO integration.

step.cmd: Use your browser to navigate to access.redhat.com

step.stepresult: You are redirected to your company single sign-on login screen.

step.cmd: Enter your company username and password credentials. This is the same information you use to log in to your company single sign-on system, which also provides access to your Red Hat account because it is federated with Red Hat’s single-sign on system.

result.p: After a successful login, the avatar that is associated with your user account appears in the navigation bar in place of the login icon. Click the avatar for additional account information.
